Hi Sarah / Marissa —

Thanks — we support both Ariba and Coupa supplier flows. A few practical notes to speed onboarding:
- For Ariba: we can be set up as a supplier on your side — we need the supplier registration ID (or invitation) and the "Supplier Contact" email so our ops team can accept the invite. If you provide the supplier ID, we'll confirm on our portal and link the vendor code to your PO.
- For Coupa: our finance team can accept a Coupa supplier invitation — please send the standard Coupa invitation to finance@redwood.ai.

Required fields/documents (minimally to get paid):
- Completed vendor intake form (we received yours — thanks)
- Signed W-9 (PDF)
- Banking details / ACH authorization (bank letter or voided check)
- Remit-to address and billing contact

If you prefer DocuSign, you can use this PowerForm to securely send W-9 and bank info: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123

I've attached a brief checklist (one-page) and our vendor setup contacts. Once we have either the Ariba supplier ID or the Coupa invite and your W-9/bank stub, we'll finish the onboarding and confirm the Redwood vendor code.

Best,
